hypothesis_label: Participation divergence instability as a veto on fragile pre-move setups

mechanism_contract.known_baseline_weakness: The baseline can read apparent setup readiness while missing unstable participation or divergence that makes the pre-move structure fragile.
mechanism_contract.exact_mechanism_of_improvement: Add an instability veto that blocks pre-move approvals when participation breadth, internal agreement, or divergence quality fails to confirm the apparent setup.
mechanism_contract.why_not_parameter_tuning: The proposal adds a new instability filter tied to participation divergence, not a generic threshold change on the existing ladder.
mechanism_contract.why_expected_edge_should_survive_strict_: If valid, the filter should consistently remove fragile setups with weak internal confirmation rather than improve only on one calibration slice.

required_evidence_inputs: deterministic participation or breadth confirmation evidence
deterministic divergence or instability evidence available before expansion
allowed_scope: pre-expansion participation confirmation or divergence instability evidence
new fragility veto state before expansion
optional secondary compare against phase68i_dynamic_ladder_candidate for overlay/context suitability only
forbidden_scope: generic multi-filter accretion without a distinct mechanism
